items.title: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Holds Bitcoin in a Coinbase Wallet, Filing Shows
items.summary: Two entries in his annual disclosure put the holding somewhere between $16,000 and $65,000, alongside more than $1 million in cash.

items.title: Bond volatility surges while bitcoin and Wall Street stay calm
items.summary: Bond volatility is at its highest since March, while the bitcoin VIX, BVIV and Wall Street's VIX remain near its yearly low.

items.title: IBIT options price trading more calmly after Bitcoin rebound
items.summary: IBIT’s expected volatility sits near the bottom of its 12-month range, according to Saxo Bank’s analysis of options data from Sept.

items.title: Ethena expands USDe backing strategy into bStocks and equity perpetuals on Binance
items.summary: Ethena is adding Binance bStocks and equity perpetuals to the basis trade used for USDe's backing strategy.
